notes.title: Character Introduction: Kaboom x Steam Space Exploration Fest
notes.content:
Introducing the most explosive bastard you will encounter in Space!

Howdy y'all

Today, we're celebrating the start of Steam Space Exploration Fest with a rundown of Kaboom! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/9bdfde829175c02f2e634d9d70a7a7859af094fc.gif

Bio:

Huyon "Kaboom" Li was born in the Kram mines and suffered for years by being repeatedly blown up by his careless human bosses. As soon as he had the chance, Kaboom fled the mines to pursue his dream of xenogeology study, and has been on the run ever since.

He dreams of earning a place back in society as a licensed xenogeologist by locating and claiming the great gem motherlode. Unfortunately, Human law will never forgive a runaway xeno, no matter how much he contributes to science.

Weapon: Dynamite 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/9712731179ac5415b859b9712272e4b22130e2e6.gif

Damage: High
Range: Medium/ Short
Rate of Fire: Low
Ammo Capacity: Low
Special Notes: Exploding dynamite makes Kaboom one of the few bastards with an AOE attack! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Stunt: Mist Form

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/d700a9f3e04ab2bd409fbcfb1ea979547610caa1.gif

Mist form allows Kaboom to become temporarily invisible, which helps in any sticky situation you may come under. Pretty useful right? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

In Conclusion
Perfect when outnumbered or against packed enemies, Kaboom is great to pair with a Bastard who is strong against isolated enemies, such as Judge or Hopalong! 

Check out Wild Bastards and other games in the Steam Space Exploration Fest. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/93a6c19ce735d834ad9d41d4d2472d450ad6aa20.jpg

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Sarge
notes.content:
Introducing the most badass horses you may encounter in Space!

Howdy y'all

Today, we have a rundown of the failed experiments that'll free every horse in the galaxy! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/a19c25a4a4b56ec43966e557c69483bb49beec40.gif

Bio:

After a failed military experiment to fuse horse genes and Kram-robot parts Sarge survived..

The unit proved to be an expensive mistake and was sent on a series of suicide missions. 
Sarge survived. 

They sent a platoon to liquidate the last living asset. 
Sarge survived.

His only and last goal now is to track down and liberate the last living horses in the galaxy.

Weapon: Repeater rifle 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7c66b3cbc4a383d95c030bf3d74f887e78550b66.gif

Damage: High
Range: Medium/ Long
Rate of Fire: Low
Ammo Capacity: Low
Special Notes: Sarge has a better radar than other Bastards and can spot enemies more easily, pretty convenient right? 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Stunt: Fortify

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/452db91e700549f40ddee5a4ad84133697aa4544.gif

Fortify, offers you better protection and also can reflect your bullets directly to their opponents.
Pretty useful right? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

In Conclusion
Sarge is the solid bastard that can easily get the back of a more squishy partner, Ideal to pick when you need to defend and survive. 

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Billy the Squid
notes.content:
Introducing the gunslinger that wants to be famous!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/f39b839f321287b753b3d93bb0ab9506d65bd229.gif

Howdy y'all

Today, we have a rundown of the gang's most theatrical bastard in the galaxy! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Bio:

Billy grew up on one of the few independent farm planets. Bored and humiliated by this life, he ran away from the kelp farm at an early age to become a gunfighter and killer of men.

He idolizes gunfighters, and he only wants to be a legendary, famous gunfighter. 
Yes, he probably watched too many Cowboys movies 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Weapon: Dual Pistols 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/975bb0e16a0a6636c1ab86047eed902046bd8d09.gif

Damage: Medium
Range: Medium
Rate of Fire: High
Ammo Capacity: Low
Special Notes: Reloading can be a bit long, but you can interrupt it to defend yourself in sticky situations.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Stunt: Bullet Storm

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/8eac7f220457023d86ac9d0910a789cc7f6eaf69.gif

Bullet Storm allows Billy to have a high fire rate and reload rate, it's perfect when you are surrounded by enemies. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

In Conclusion
Billy is a powerful squid and an amazing gunslinger, but he's quite squishy and will need a solid backup in case things go wrong! 

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Roswell
notes.content:
The top secret outlaw of Wild Bastards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/ad788671c9bc9d05a8851c2a44fa4dd8b886420e.gif

Howdy y'all

Today we have a rundown of the gang's most secretive outlaw that the Men in Black didn't want you to meet: Roswell!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Bio:

After fleeing a catastrophic crash landing on Earth, Roswell spent over 1,000 years in Area 51. He could have been out sooner had you all stormed the facility like you were supposed to. 

Nonetheless, after an accidental protocol breach, Roswell escaped and made it off Earth, winding up in the Calamity sector of the frontier.

Roswell wants to go home, but home may not exist anymore...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Weapon: Self-Loading Raygun 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/834f11b007f6982c89a0d0a4bcc78c1d25aa32f7.gif

Damage: Medium
Range: Short
Rate of Fire: High
Ammo Capacity: Low
Special Notes: You don't have any ammo, but you need to be careful to avoid overheating your gun!

Roswell can do a lot of damage and easily get rid of enemies with low HP. However, be careful against more solid enemies; one full load might not be enough!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Stunt: Blast Off
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/0be479d4f71227ae10dda0d5e0b38d3d270eda0e.gif


Blast Off makes Roswell jump multiple times in 10 seconds, with each impact creating an explosion on the ground. This is perfect for clearing enemies when they are distant from each other or simply hiding everywhere.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

In Conclusion
Roswell is a versatile character, thanks to his stunt, but could take advantage when teaming up with a character with some real firepower!

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Preach
notes.content:
Beware our most righteous outlaw of Wild Bastards: Preach!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/851e66561847c12213aa0092c4e373506c0e35ed.gif

Howdy y'all

Today we have a rundown of our devoted outlaw, Preach. Church has faith in you, Preach has bullets for you!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png
Bio:

Valia "Preach" O'Neil was adopted as a baby by a deeply religious human pastor and his wife. At age 14, her skin turned blue, and extra fingers grew... 

Valia turned out to be a polymorphic alien. The Pastor became enraged and attempted to kill her. Mother tried to protect her, but he made it clear they were both guilty in the eyes of his lord. 

Valia stopped him with a Gatling gun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Weapon: Gatling Gun 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/ffec70340839adcbe4005ec7ff6fa12a488cf44f.gif

Damage: Medium
Range: Short/Medium
Rate of Fire: High
Ammo Capacity: High
Special Notes: Rata tata!

Preach is pretty comfortable dealing with multiple sinners, the Gatling gun offers her a good way to deal with a lot of enemies.

However, Preach is there to shoot many bullets, not to aim. Her accuracy is her low point, you'll need to use mods to avoid being a short-range fighter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

Stunt: Sermon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/93c348f08c6c8ddd38caede61103ec4640969c87.gif


Sermon allows Preach to heal on each hit for 10 seconds, this is the perfect skill to deal with difficult situations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/7dbaa4f95ce7db60e7a63acf9eb93803c7061746.png

In Conclusion
Preach is the perfect pick to deal with many enemies with low health points but will struggle against High-health lawmen. 

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Hopalong
notes.content:
Introducing the greatest Rancher of Wild Bastards: Hopalong!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/a71c0c3a5c3eee2e11d7dc07842b45c6f4b8f0c5.gif

Howdy y'all

Today we have a rundown of our Snakiest rancher, Hopalong. It's time to dream big, wake up and realize this world is like putting socks on a rooster. 

Bio:
The Young Vansak "Hopalong" Largo grew up dreaming of becoming a real rancher on the frontier, but for young aliens like Hopalong this was not actually possible.  

Years of mistreatment led him to eventually escape the work camp he was assigned to, and Hopalong hopped along to the Calamity sector to disappear.

Hopalong still believes he can be a great rancher if he can just find some peaceful land. But the world doesn't work like that...

Weapon: Lasso 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/050a45ce1643d0894051776218dc26752490dbf2.gif

Damage: Medium
Range: Short
Rate of Fire: Medium
Ammo Capacity: Unlimited
Special Notes: The longer you hold someone in your lasso, the more damage you'll deal. The enemy caught can't move until they are released or dead!

Hopalong's lasso allows you to face powerful enemies without any problem, as long as they are alone.
Attacking an enemy makes you vulnerable to those who are close enough to shoot you!

However, as a snake, you don't run to your enemies; you slither, making you faster and more difficult to hit!

Stunt: Whip crack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/eaa8e32b84cefd4c54bfb197cc63094da1567a9a.gif

Whip crack stuns all enemies on the map for a few seconds, giving you some time to finish the most dangerous enemies.

The main flaw of Hopalong is that it's really difficult to kill enemies when they are grouped together! Whip crack is perfect in these scenarios because it allows you to kill them one by one without taking any risks!

In Conclusion
Hopalong is the perfect pick to strangle powerful and isolated enemies, but will struggle against grouped enemies. The best strategy is to pair him with someone good at taking on multiple enemies at once!


Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Judge
notes.content:
Introducing the Most [strike]Tempermental[/strike] Judgemental Wild Bastard: Judge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/d8ac6bf7c829523bb705cabd37ab6ef40682734e.png
All the fun of capital punishment without the boring trial!

Howdy y'all

Saddle up pardner! It's time to make like a rodeo and scream yeehaw for no apparent reason. YeeeeeEEEEeeeehaw!! Today, we've got a breakdown of the most mood-swingin' Bastard, Judge. What he lacks in basic human empathy, he makes up for with a cool gun.

Bio:
"The Judge" Justice Unit 939 served as a model Justice of the peace for over 50 years. He was so strict in his adherence to the law that he sentenced his own wife and son to disassembly for breaking robot curfew.

Overcome with grief, he fled to the frontier, where he earns a living killing human authority figures.

Weapon: Sniper Rifle
[previewyoutube=VFIcJJAWtq8;full][/previewyoutube]
Damage: High
Range: Long
Rate of Fire: Low
Ammo Capacity: Extremely Low
Special Notes: Upon getting three headshots, your next shot will automatically do crit damage.

Judge's Sniper Rifle is all about clicking heads. You can hipfire with absolute precision or use the zoom to make sure your shots are lined up. Either way, each headshot rewards you with a tic, where if you get 3 headshots, you'll automatically do massive damage on your next shot.

However, due to Judge's poor stock rate of fire and ammo capacity, he suffers greatly from poor crowd control. He can deal with single enemies up close, but missing your shot will keep you toothless for a long time while you reload. The judicial system always had its gaping flaws, and this bot is no different.

Stunt: Judgement Time
[previewyoutube=MjohTYadcVY;full][/previewyoutube]

Judgement Time gives you Keanu powers for 10 seconds by slowing down the world around you, allowing you to shoot and reload in real time while your enemies struggle to even turn.

Use this whenever you're in a critical situation being surrounded by enemies or at low health. You'll learn how to instantly dodge bullets and know Gun-Fu in an instant.

Xtra Bastard Goodness

[previewyoutube=XBVFAAzOj5s;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=Cjbs1sWfjxA;full][/previewyoutube]

In Conclusion
Judge is a nasty powerhouse who will take down almost every type of common enemy before they even realize their being hunted. However, once they close in on you-- you'll need to use stocked up Stunts or switch to a shorter range Bastard (like Smoky) to enforce some crowd control.

Judge's shortcomings can be somewhat mitigated with certain mods, but we'll have more on that later.

Be sure to wishlist our game for more updates soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660840/Wild_Bastards/

See you next time, when we go through Hopalong-- the snake-like creature with an affinity for roping up his enemies.

Until next time gunslinger!

notes.title: Character Introduction: Smoky
notes.content:
Introducing the Flamiest Wild Bastard: Smoky
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/d930ab5de7970e722a2887c91f2f8b46e488541a.png
WHO LET HIM COOK?!

Howdy y'all, 

Today, we're starting a new series to introduce y'all to the Wild Bastards gang! We'll be sharing insights into the outlaws and their playstyles. For our first Bastard, we're coming in hot by pouring some gasoline on today's Bastard to watch him catch ablaze. Introducing Smoky!

Bio:
Algernon "Smoky" Johnson was a young successful chef on his way to the top. A kitchen fire triggered his mutant genes and he was cast out of pure human society. He now lives in a state of constant pain and conflagration.

All-in-all, Smoky just wants to cook great meals, and he doesn't really care what it's made out of.

Weapon: Flamethrower
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/3cb2d778fcdd4fa53cedd66847cbd767fff6330b.gif

Damage: Moderate
Range: Short-Medium
Rate of Fire: Extremely Fast
Ammo Capacity: Moderately High
Special Notes: Upon hitting the floor, turns into flame carpet. Upon direct contact with shot or flame carpet, ignites enemies and damages them over time.

Smoky's Flamethrower is a completely unique weapon in the Wild Bastards universe that allows him to use his extremely fast rate of fire with the special flame carpet effect for multiple strategies. Use this combination to deal with numerous short to medium ranged enemies with ease. Due to his short range, he's not the greatest outlaw to go after distant enemies.

Stunt: Cookout
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/52085b5313aa0634bd8362b6fa2ca7b3d2c8d0b0.gif

Cookout immediately ignites all enemies within a large radius around Smoky, letting them burn until they turn into smoldering ashes. Use this stunt when you're surrounded or just can't find where those last enemies are hiding.

Xtra Bastard Goodness

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771598/ed086b9942d648e015f75d02254ee98c82ea548e.jpg

[previewyoutube=SDk30V6cJqE;full][/previewyoutube]

In Conclusion
Smoky fits great with almost every other Bastard, and especially does well with a long-range one to make up for his limitations. As stated, he's also great at going solo as long as his weaknesses are accounted for.

With great crowd control and some of the best mod versatility, you're going to love frying up some beans with Smoky.

Be sure to Wishlist Wild Bastards and follow us on Steam for more updates soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660840/Wild_Bastards/

Until next time gunslinger!
